lpEyebrow: A voice-first business partner for small merchants
lpHeroTitle: Your shop's munim, in your language.
lpHeroSub: Munim briefs you every morning, answers from your own sales data, warns you before cash runs short, and acts only when you approve.
lpHeroNote: Demo with synthetic data for Lakshmi Kirana, Kukatpally, Hyderabad.
lpProblemTitle: Running a shop means a lot of guessing
lpProblemSub: Three questions every shopkeeper asks, with no simple place to get the answer.
lpQ1a: Sales dip and nobody explains why. Dashboards are in English and built for analysts.
lpQ2: Will I have cash for the supplier?
lpQ2a: A big payment lands, cash is short, and credit shows up too late.
lpQ3a: Good customers quietly stop coming, and there is no easy way to notice.
lpHowTitle: From a morning briefing to a decision you control
lpStep1B: Every morning Munim speaks a short briefing in your language: yesterday's sales against a usual day, and the one thing that needs attention.
lpStep2B: Speak or type any question. The answer comes from your own sales data, and you can see the exact query behind it.
lpStep3B: A 14-day cash forecast shows the day cash may run short, with and without a pre-approved credit offer.
lpStep4B: Munim drafts the action, like an offer to lapsed regulars. Nothing goes out until you confirm.
lpAskSub: Munim never makes up a number. It runs a query on your data, and you can open the exact SQL and rows behind any answer.
lpAskNote: The question, answer, query and rows are real output from the demo data.
lpCashTitle: See the gap before it happens
lpCashSub: The forecast marks the first day cash goes below zero. A pre-approved credit offer shows what would change, and the choice stays yours.
lpCashNote: Demo forecast, not a guarantee. Interest and repayment terms are not provided in the demo.
lpGrowTitle: Win back customers who stopped coming
lpGrowSub: Munim finds regulars who haven't visited in 14 days or more and drafts an offer for them.
lpGrowControl: Edit it, approve it, or reject it. Nothing is sent until you confirm, and in the demo the send is simulated.
lpTrustTitle: Built so you can check it
lpTrust1B: Answers come from SQL queries on your data, run through a read-only database role. You can open each one.
lpTrust2T: The AI never writes a number
lpTrust2B: A check rejects any number in a spoken answer that the query did not return.
lpTrust3B: Credit and customer offers wait for your confirmation. Voice or tap, the same rule applies.
lpVoiceSub: The briefing is spoken in English, Hindi or Telugu. These are the real clips from the demo, with their text.
lpRealTitle: What is real, and what is simulated
lpSimHead: Simulated, and labelled in the app
lpReal1: A synthetic data pipeline with five planted stories
lpReal2: SQL-grounded answers on a read-only database role
lpReal3: Agent routing with an approval gate
lpReal4: The cash forecast and the credit rule
lpReal5: Speech in and out, and voice yes or no
lpSim2: The promo send and the credit disbursal
lpStoryTitle: What to look for in the demo
lpStory1: Weekday evenings (6-9 pm) sell about a third less than the midday peak.
lpStory2: Yesterday earned ₹8,200, 12% below the usual Wednesday (₹9,320).
lpStory3: The 9 Nov settlement is ₹1,420 short: ₹890 in refunds and ₹530 in fees.
lpStory4: 40 regular customers haven't visited in 14 days or more.
lpStory5: Cash goes below zero on 19 Nov because of a ₹45,000 supplier payment. A ₹30,000 pre-approved credit offer covers it.
